Is it a good idea to explicitly call out the size of operands in the EIP e.g. EIP-7? I can send a PR to update EIP-7 but just wanna run the idea through this group first I don't think it's necessary for opcodes pulling from the stack. The EVM is a 256-bit word machine. excerpts.author: xinbenlv
excerpts.content: Is it a good idea to explicitly call out the size of operands in the EIP e.g. EIP-7? I can send a PR to update EIP-7 but just wanna run the idea through this group first

excerpts.author: samwilsn
excerpts.content:
I don't think it's necessary for opcodes pulling from the stack. The EVM is a 256-bit word machine.

If your argument is anything other than a 256-bit unsigned integer, then yes, you should specify that.
